_readme: THE FIGHT'S FLOORS (SOUNDS 10/18/26, row [the step in the fight]): what a shoe lands on, per tile of every block of COMBAT TWO's fight ground, read off the block's own picture by tools/bohemia_sounds_fight_floors.py. floor[y][x] names a sprite in this folder (steps_<floor>.mp3). The rule, first match wins: a casino block is carpet; a kit-plan road piece is asphalt; a tile drawn at least 30 percent dark grey is asphalt; everything else is the gravel walk ('dirt'). The fight's own terrain (flat, rough, ...) is copied beside it for reading, never used: it is a cost, not a material.
